channel.label: Cooler Temperature
channel.description: Current temperature of the cooler (fridge) compartment reported by the refrigerator.

channel.label: Cooler Target Temperature
channel.description: Target temperature of the cooler (fridge) compartment, writable within the refrigerator-reported range and increment.

channel.label: Freezer Temperature
channel.description: Current temperature of the freezer compartment reported by the refrigerator.

channel.label: Freezer Target Temperature
channel.description: Target temperature of the freezer compartment, writable within the refrigerator-reported range and increment.

channel.label: Cooler Door
channel.description: Whether the cooler (fridge) door is open or closed.

channel.label: Freezer Door
channel.description: Whether the freezer door is open or closed.

channel.label: Power Cool
channel.description: Power Cool (rapid fridge) mode of the refrigerator. Enable or disable it with On or Off; writes require remote control.

channel.label: Power Freeze
channel.description: Power Freeze (rapid freezing) mode of the refrigerator. Enable or disable it with On or Off; writes require remote control.

channel.label: Operating Mode
channel.description: Operating mode reported by the refrigerator.

channel.label: Power Consumption
channel.description: Instantaneous electrical power reported by the refrigerator.

channel.label: Cumulative Energy
channel.description: Cumulative energy reported by the refrigerator.
